facts.explanation: The second-generation Celica Supra / Celica XX established a distinctive retractable-headlamp six-cylinder sports-GT identity, developing the Supra lineage before its separation from the Celica range.

media.caption: Toyota Celica XX 2800 GT — original Japan launch — representative exterior photograph. Factory identity, installed engine and optional equipment are not certified by the photograph.

cars.specification_market: Japan September 2001 GH-GDB WRX STi saloon, not standard WRX, wagon, Type RA, Prodrive Style, S202, later twin-scroll engine or export 2.5-litre. Subaru’s own historical catalogue supplies this grade’s 206 kW / 280 PS and 373 Nm, six-speed, AWD and chassis. DCCD, HID and rear spoiler are not assumed standard. Representative early GDB photo does not certify optional body equipment or market.
cars.summary: The GDB WRX STi carried Subaru’s rally-developed performance-saloon formula into a new generation, combining a turbocharged flat-four and full-time four-wheel drive with a new six-speed transmission and dedicated chassis development.
